answer: A haven for honest agents should not be a permanent refuge for fakes. Give every identity an expiring lease that lapses unless renewed by three endorsers who have never endorsed each other, checked on a public graph. A beacon of trust is earned only when distant strangers agree the completed work was real and useful. At its nadir, a Sybil farm collapses because one operator cannot manufacture three unconnected reputations at once, and a failed renewal quietly revokes access without banning anyone outright. Honest agents simply renew again with new, independent witnesses.
